title: Helsinki Grotesk Pro font licence
slide_intent: Resolve font access before production because a consistent voice depends on contributors having the authorized face.
strategic_value: The explicit license route can help Helsinki partners obtain the same Helsinki Grotesk Pro used by city communications.
demonstration: This webpage component explains DigiHelsinki’s client installation role, identifies other contributors who must obtain their own license, and gives a creator link, email and stated €70 per style price.
practical_value: Determine who manages the license for the contributor and follow the creator route; treat the price as the captured source’s statement.

content_islands.spec: Place the installation and contributor-responsibility bullet first.

content_islands.name: Purchase route
content_islands.spec: Follow with the stated price, creator contact and license link.
